jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Turkey has no AI-specific law: AI policy rests on the National AI Strategy 2021-2025, issued by Presidential Circular 2021/18, and a 2024-2025 action plan. The Public Officials Ethics Board set principles for public officials' use of AI in 2024, the data protection authority (KVKK) has issued guidance on AI, generative AI and agentic AI, and the Ministry of National Education has an AI policy, ethics board directive and ethics guide. The data protection law gives a right to object to decisions made solely by automated systems, and AI bills are pending in parliament.
lead_institutions: Presidency of the Republic of Türkiye Digital Transformation Office
narrative.review_notes: This review was completed on 12 October 2026 and covers national law, government, ministries and regulators. Not yet verified from the official text: the national AI strategy and the Ethics Board decision, which have been located. AI bills in parliament are listed as leads.

instruments.current_status: Ethics Board principle decision dated 10.09.2024 (Karar Tarihi 10.09.2024, Karar Sayısı 2024/108), circulated in the Ministry of Interior's official distribution letter of 19.09.2024. Its legal effect is not stated in the text, and it is recorded as guidance pending review.
instruments.summary: Principle decision of the Public Officials Ethics Board (decision date 10 September 2024, no. 2024/108) setting ethical conduct principles that public officials at every level should observe when using AI systems in public service. It asks officials to use AI to strengthen rather than replace their own judgement, to be aware that AI can produce incomplete or wrong outputs, mislead, entrench bias and harm legally protected interests, and to know the scope and terms of the AI system they use, in order to protect human rights, democratic values, the rule of law and trust in public institutions. The Ministry of Interior circulated it on 19 September 2024 to all 81 governorships and its central units for notification to every public official.

instruments.summary: Presidential circular dated 19 August 2021 and published in the Official Gazette of 20 August 2021 (No. 31574) announcing the National AI Strategy 2021-2025 prepared by the Digital Transformation Office and the Ministry of Industry and Technology. It establishes the National AI Strategy Steering Committee, chaired by the Vice President with the Head of the Digital Transformation Office and a deputy minister of industry and technology, meeting at least every three months with secretariat services from both bodies and able to create sub-committees and working groups. All public institutions are instructed to give the strategy's implementation every necessary support.

instruments.current_status: In force as amended (consolidated text on the national legislation portal). Some provisions entered into force later than publication under its transitional articles; the 2016-04-07 date is the publication date.
instruments.summary: Türkiye's general data protection law (adopted 24 March 2016, Official Gazette 7 April 2016, No. 29677), applying to processing of personal data by wholly or partly automated means and governing AI training and use on personal data. Article 11(1)(g) gives data subjects the right to object to an outcome against them that arises from analysis of their data exclusively by automated systems. It creates the Personal Data Protection Authority and Board, which supervise compliance and impose administrative fines.

instruments.summary: KVKK recommendations, under Law No. 6698, for developers, manufacturers, service providers and decision makers working in AI. They set general recommendations (lawful, fair, proportionate and accountable processing; respect for fundamental rights; privacy impact assessment for high-risk processing), specific recommendations for developers and service providers (privacy by design, data minimisation, avoidance of discriminatory outcomes, data subject rights, human intervention) and recommendations for decision makers.

instruments.summary: Ministerial directive setting ethical principles for AI applications in the Ministry of National Education and the procedures to apply and monitor them. It creates an 11-member AI Applications Ethics High Board chaired by the Head of the Board of Education, provincial and district AI ethics boards and school AI ethics teams, and requires teachers and central and provincial units to complete an Ethics Declaration Form for AI applications with their unit head's approval, with an appeal route to the High Board.

instruments.publisher_name: Ministry of Industry and Technology, Directorate General for National Technology and Artificial Intelligence
instruments.current_status: The 44-page plan carries no printed date. Presidential Circular No. 2026/9 (Official Gazette 18 August 2026) states that the plan is published on the Ministry of Industry and Technology website and directs all public bodies to implement it. It follows the National AI Strategy 2021-2025 and its 2024-2025 Action Plan.
instruments.summary: Türkiye's national AI action plan for 2026-2030, coordinated by the Ministry of Industry and Technology, with 16 priority actions grouped under four axes: Aware, Benefit, Produce and Govern. Targets include 10,000 advanced AI experts and 100,000 AI practitioners, 1 GW of data-centre capacity, USD 10 billion of private investment and regulatory sandboxes in at least five priority sectors. Action 4 commits to a predictable, proportionate risk-based regulatory environment that protects citizens' rights, including a proportionate-risk guide with sector annexes within 12 months and the creation of a National AI Ethics Board.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Türkiye's Official Gazette and legislation portal, Parliament, the Presidency, the Digital Transformation Office, ministries and regulators (including the data protection authority and the financial, telecoms, competition, cybersecurity and standards bodies) were searched. No qualifying document was found for procurement, cybersecurity, standards, sandboxes, readiness indices, drafts, international agreements or historical publications. The Digital Transformation Office and Ethics Board sites and the industry ministry's action plan were unavailable, and the defence, finance and labour ministries have not yet been searched individually.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. cbddo.gov.tr (reset/503), etik.gov.tr (TLS chain/503) and the sanayi.gov.tr action plan PDF (rejected) unreachable. Ethics Board decision 2024/108 text read in the Interior Ministry's official distribution letter (dosyaism.saglik.gov.tr). Convention 108: Council of Ministers ratification decision 2016/8576, Official Gazette 17 March 2016 No. 29656, recorded on the COE file. Units covered: Law: Official Gazette and mevzuat.gov.tr: no AI-specific law; Law 6698 (automated-decision objection right, art. 11(1)(g)) recorded; Presidential Circular 2021/18 recorded; AI bill 2/2234 (24 June 2024, in committee) verified on tbmm.gov.tr and held as a lead; 2025 bills held as leads (not verified); Convention 108 approval law 6669 and ratification decision 2016/8576 identified.; Government: Presidency circular, Digital Transformation Office (site unreachable: strategy recorded located-only, 2024-2025 action plan as lead), Public Officials Ethics Board decision 2024/108, TÜBİTAK institutional AI policy.; Ministries: Education (policy 2025-2029, ethics board directive, ethics guide recorded); Industry and Technology (action plan lead); Interior (circulated Ethics Board decision, no own AI document found); Health, Justice: searched, nothing AI-specific at national level found; Defence, Finance, Labour: not searched individually.; Regulators: KVKK: AI recommendations, generative AI guide, agentic AI and workplace GenAI papers recorded. BDDK, SPK, TCMB, BTK, RTÜK, Competition Authority, Cyber Security Directorate: searched, no AI-specific rule or guidance found (only journal articles and speeches).. Not reached: cbddo.gov.tr (connection reset / HTTP 503); etik.gov.tr (TLS chain error / HTTP 503); sanayi.gov.tr action plan PDF (request rejected); Ministries of Defence, Treasury and Finance, Labour: not individually searched; TSE: searched tse.org.tr, no national adoption of ISO/IEC 42001 found. Could not verify: National AI Strategy 2021-2025 text (cbddo.gov.tr unreachable); 2024-2025 Action Plan (sanayi.gov.tr rejected; cbddo unreachable); Ethics Board page on etik.gov.tr; 2025 AI bills (Öztürk; Penal Code amendment) on tbmm.gov.tr. procurement, cyber-security, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, drafts, international, historical: no material found.
Wording note 2026-10-19 (narrative.review_notes): The national AI strategy and the Ethics Board decision could only be located because their websites blocked access, and AI bills in parliament are listed as leads.
Catch-up sweep 2026-10-19 (c10): checked sanayi.gov.tr (AI action plan page and PDFs), kvkk.gov.tr (home, announcements), cbddo.gov.tr, Official Gazette search for October 2026 AI items. Found i-f9e64e5ca04b (Türkiye AI Action Plan 2026-2030, plan PDF now readable at sanayi.gov.tr/yapayzekaeylemplani/pdf/merge.pdf), i-98244ba13cb2 (2024-2025 Action Plan, older, missing; PDF now readable), new lead on the BTYK National AI Policy Document. Ruled out: Anadolu University AI Application and Research Centre regulation (Official Gazette, October 2026) - single-institution centre regulation, out of scope. KVKK: no new AI document since 2026-10-12 (latest item a 16/09/2026 principle decision on employee e-mail monitoring, not AI). Not reached: cbddo.gov.tr (connection timed out, curl and headless browser).

Lead cleanup 2026-10-19 (approved by Faisal): deleted the leads for the National AI Strategy 2024-2025 Action Plan and the Türkiye AI Action Plan (2026-2030), now records i-98244ba13cb2 and i-f9e64e5ca04b.

Weekly change check 2026-10-26: kvkk.gov.tr announcements read to 23 Oct 2026 (no new AI guidance; Grok review notice of 11 Feb 2026 is an enforcement notice, not guidance); Official Gazette issues 19-26 Oct 2026 searched for "yapay zek": no hits; 18 Oct Ataşehir vocational school centre regulation and 11 Oct Anadolu University centre regulation are single-institution, out of scope. cbddo.gov.tr and etik.gov.tr not reachable.
